message: Scribe is software that records the steps of work done in apps and turns them into step-by-step how-to guides, which an IT team could use instead of keeping procedures in individual heads. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: On the free Basic plan, the buyer can create an account and use Scribe in the browser to record one browser-based IT procedure and generate a shareable step-by-step how-to guide from it, with sensitive data redacted automatically. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
